market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI hit ~$111 on May 1 amid Hormuz closure but pulled back to ~$102. Question requires CME settlement (not intraday high) at >=$115 on any trading day through end of June. Settlement is harder than intraday but EIA pegs Q2 Brent peak ~$115 and analysts see range $105-125 for May. With ~2 months and ongoing supply shock, plausible but not assured.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether geopolitical premium sustains until a daily settle clears $115.
